tree.heading: Finding of Secretary
tree.text: If the Secretary finds that an order issued under section 6203(a) of this title, or a provision of such order, obstructs or does not tend to effectuate the purposes of this chapter, the Secretary shall terminate or suspend the operation of such order or provision.

tree.heading: Periodic referenda
tree.text: The Secretary may periodically conduct a referendum to determine if lime producers, producer-handlers, and importers favor the continuation, termination, or suspension of any order issued under section 6203(a) of this title and in effect at the time of such referendum.

tree.heading: Required referenda
tree.text: The Secretary shall hold a referendum under subsection (b)—

children.text: at the request of the Board; or
if not less than 10 percent of the lime producers, producer-handlers, and importers subject to assessment under this chapter submit a petition requesting such a referendum.

tree.heading: Limitation
tree.text: The termination or suspension of any order, or any provision thereof, shall not be considered an order within the meaning of this chapter.

tree.heading: Vote
tree.text: The Secretary shall suspend or terminate the order at the end of the marketing year if the Secretary determines that—

children.text: the suspension or termination of the order is favored by not less than a majority of those persons voting in a referendum under subsection (b); and
the producers, producer-handlers, and importers comprising this majority produce and import more than 50 percent of the volume of limes produced and imported by those voting in the referendum.
